UniApp is an independent project developed by Anto426 to access the University of Molise’s services. The app is not an official university product. Official university portals, notices, and procedures remain the authoritative reference for academic activities.

The About screen displays the installed version and included components. New Android builds require Android 10 or later and an ARM64 device; 32-bit systems and x86/x86_64 architectures are not supported. Availability on iOS depends on project distribution via the App Store.

Author details and contributor acknowledgements come from public GitHub data. Displayed contributions refer to the UniApp repository; counts reflect the data made available by GitHub and may update on a different schedule than source commits.

The source code can be inspected in the [project repository](https://github.com/Anto426-Project/uniapp). Usage and redistribution are governed by the licenses specified in the repository and included components. Third-party names, trademarks, and content belong to their respective owners.

UniApp uses a single update channel. Android APKs are published in the [project’s GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Anto426-Project/UniappUpstream/releases); the system checks installation compatibility. On iOS, updates open in the App Store when available. Any mandatory update conditions are shown in the interface.

Bugs and suggestions can be reported on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Anto426-Project/uniapp/issues). The draft prepared by the app includes build and module info; publishing it requires your action on GitHub. Issues are public: review the text and remove any personal data from attachments before submitting.

The information below applies to UniApp, an independent project by Anto426. University services, the proxy used by certain features, and distribution or notification platforms have their own operators and privacy notices. This page does not replace privacy disclosures provided by those parties.

Entered credentials and session tokens enable access to services associated with your account. Academic features use data returned by those services: university profiles and identities, career, courses, exams, grades, tuition fees, questionnaires, and bookings. Operations you confirm may transmit, alongside authentication data, the responses or identifiers required to complete them. Without service-required data, the corresponding operation may be unavailable.

UniApp stores credentials, sessions, preferences, and data caches needed for its features using the platform’s secure storage. Academic data is isolated per account and profile. Android uses encrypted files backed by Keystore keys; iOS uses Keychain. Protection also depends on your operating system and device hardware. Biometric verification is handled by the OS: the app never collects fingerprints or face templates.

Academic features communicate with app.unimol.it, unimol.esse3.cineca.it, and trasporti.unimol.it. Certain requests use the proxy sync.faufas.it. These services receive the data required for each request—which may include credentials or tokens—along with technical connection metadata. Consult the privacy notices of each service operator for details on responsibilities, purposes, legal bases, retention, and any international transfers.

Scanning QR codes requires camera access. To record attendance, the service may require the QR code, location, and reported accuracy: permission is managed in system settings. Notifications use Firebase Cloud Messaging on Android and Apple services on iOS. Device registration may transmit notification tokens, device model, operating system, and app version. App toggles and OS permissions control separate features; revoking a permission may make the corresponding feature unavailable.

Update checks, APK downloads, and contributor credits use GitHub and its distribution services. Such requests transmit standard technical connection data. Credits may be cached locally for offline viewing. The graphics SDK inspects device capabilities and runs local measurements to select and save a performance profile that tunes UI rendering. For GitHub, see the [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

The app opens a draft issue on GitHub and never automatically uploads logs or academic data. When you publish the draft, its title, text, and attachments become visible according to repository settings. Automated workflows may read issue text to apply labels and ask for missing details. Never post passwords, tokens, student IDs, documents, or other people’s personal data. Editing or deleting posted content depends on GitHub features and terms.

Local copies are refreshed by their respective features and may persist between sessions. You can remove an account inside the app to delete its local data using the built-in management tools. General app preferences and shared app data are kept separate from per-account storage. Signing out or removing an account from UniApp does not delete your university account or data held by external services, which remain subject to their respective retention policies.

Where provided by applicable law, you may exercise rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability with the relevant data controller. For university and other external services, use the contacts provided in their privacy notices. You may also lodge a complaint with the [Italian Data Protection Authority](https://www.garanteprivacy.it/home/diritti). Public UniApp GitHub issues are intended for technical bugs and are not a confidential channel for personal-data requests.
Purpose and independence of the project

UniApp provides an independent interface for viewing and using university services. The project does not represent the University of Molise, CINECA, or any other operators of connected services. Using the app does not alter your relationship with those organizations or the terms governing their services.

Use only accounts you are authorized to access and verify that the correct profile is selected before confirming any action. Safeguard your credentials and device. Do not use the app to bypass access controls, interfere with services, or access another person’s data without authorization.

Displayed information comes from connected services or local caches and may not immediately reflect the most recent changes. Always check official university channels for deadlines, payments, bookings, and academic results. If an error or connection drop occurs, check the outcome on the relevant official service before retrying an action that may already have been processed.

New Android releases are distributed for ARM64 devices running a compatible Android version via a single release channel. An update may be required to keep using the app once an installed version is no longer supported. Android installation remains subject to system checks and permissions. User distribution on iOS takes place via the App Store when available.

Use, modification, and redistribution of the source code follow the licenses applicable to the project and third-party components. These terms do not grant rights over the trademarks, data, or content of connected services; permissions must be verified with their respective owners.

You can contribute via pull requests or report reproducible issues on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Anto426-Project/uniapp/issues). Post only material you are authorized to share, free of credentials and unnecessary personal data. Automated issue triaging does not confirm reproducibility or imply a commitment to fix within a specific timeframe.

UniApp’s operation also depends on network connectivity, device compatibility, and external services. Errors, outages, or changes to available features may occur, and uninterrupted availability is not guaranteed. Liability and rights that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law remain unaffected.

These terms and data processing disclosures can be accessed directly in the app. The revision date identifies the version bundled in the build; changes are visible in the repository history. Terms for external services may be updated independently by their respective operators.

UniApp uses local storage, tokens, and technical cookies from connected services to maintain sessions and complete requested actions—such as accessing academic records and managing shuttle reservations.

UI settings, sign-in preferences, and local copies of fetched data are managed separately from browser sessions on external websites. The graphics SDK also saves a local performance profile tailored to your device.

You can manage accounts and preferences in UniApp settings and revoke permissions in system settings. Clearing local data may require signing in or configuring settings again. Deleting local data on your device does not erase data stored by external services.

The distribution website saves your theme choice in your browser. When you open GitHub, the App Store, university portals, or other websites, your browser and the opened service handle their own sessions and storage mechanisms according to their notices. Removing an account from UniApp does not clear browser data.
